The first residential summer camp for boys is offered by the YMCA of 
Montreal, 20 enrol 


The YMCA purchases the current site near St-Sauveur, Quebec 
The Voyageurs de la Verendrye programme is introduced 
Counsellor in Training programmes are introduced 

YMCA Kamp Kanawana becomes coeducational 

Winter outdoor and family programmes are introduced 

The first all female Voyageur trip 


The highest attendance percentages ever experienced in the summer 
camp programmes 


Year round residential services and programming is offered 


The Kanawana-Be programme is introduced for 5-6 years old 
residential campers
